changes.name: Conduit
changes.summary: Energy Barricade deploys and activates faster, with a new forward-line option and two replacement Level 2 upgrades.

changes.name: Fuse
changes.summary: Knuckle Jump and 25% explosive damage resistance join his base kit. Motherlode fires and detonates more quickly.

changes.name: Catalyst
changes.summary: Spikes can rebuild or reinforce doors on placement; cooldown falls from 20 to 15 seconds. Allies cross her wall without slowing or blindness.

changes.name: Axle & Seer
changes.summary: The included August 25 hotfix reduces Axle's drone health and stun, increases its cooldown, and removes Seer's tactical turn slowdown.
